description: Objects whose list and set attributes unify to lists of numbers fail when a set holds a non-number
notes: The spec's call rules make an argument that doesn't match its parameter's type an error, and a tuple doesn't match a list type. But the spec also says automatic conversion is attempted when a value doesn't match what an operation expects, and its conversion would succeed here: the two objects need a common type for the list, and the spec unifies a list of numbers and a set of strings to a list of strings (list and set give list, number and string give string), so both objects would convert to an object of two lists of strings. hashicorp/hcl converts the argument to the parameter's type with go-cty (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), whose conversionTupleToList unifies the converted elements (conversionUnifyListElements in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go). go-cty's unify (cty/convert/unify.go) picks a list of numbers for each attribute, because an unsafe conversion to it from the set of strings exists, and converting "x" to a number then fails.
